evidence_contract.question: Which retained scope and eligibility provisions conditionally apply to original 2024/2025 consolidated reports?
evidence_contract.baseline: Validated v6 preparation, retained primary provisions and unchanged canonical AASB executions
evidence_contract.primary_criterion: Every bounded decision has identified primary provisions, explicit reporting assumptions, effective/transition reasoning, operation consequences and unresolved dependencies
evidence_contract.promotion_veto: Unreviewed or incomplete applicability, transitions or EU implementation prevent admission
evidence_contract.continuation_veto: Corrupt provenance stops dependent decisions; resolve engineering failure before submission
evidence_contract.explanatory_only: Counts, tests and source matches establish integrity, not legal reasoning or professional accounting validity
nonclaims: No completed criterion 3 or wider MC19
No professional accounting validity, empirical forecast validity or human acceptance
